name: OmaCoin
author: crueber
description: CoinGecko crypto tracker: primary coin price in the bar, popup with tracked coins, USD price, volume, and 1h/1d/1w trend lines.

barWidget.description: Crypto prices from CoinGecko — primary coin in the bar, tracked list with trends in the popup.

schema.label: Primary coin
schema.description: CoinGecko id of the coin shown in the bar (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, ...).

schema.label: Check frequency (minutes)
schema.description: How often to poll CoinGecko, snapped to the ladder the popup's slider walks: 1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 360, 720 minutes, or 1 day. The public API accepts one call per minute at most. Default: 60 (once per hour).

schema.label: Flat band (percent)
schema.description: 24h moves smaller than this count as flat: the bar shows the price in plain white with a · glyph instead of a green/red tint. 0 disables the band. Default: 0.5.
